texts.text: At the reunion I was the tallest one there again. I'm six foot and everyone still calls me the big one, which I suppose I am next to my brothers.
I feel ugly today. Nothing changed, I just woke up feeling like the plain sister.
I said yes to the move. I didn't really want to leave, but my mother needs us closer and it felt like the right thing.
Standing in the cathedral I forgot why I came. I wasn't thinking or wanting anything, just held there by something bigger.
The traffic report was boring but the sky over the bridge was this unreal orange and I just watched it the whole way home.
I believe people deserve a second chance, even when they haven't earned it.
